rationale: All sides now agree the status quo is untenable and that any package must be durable, but the core conflict remains unresolved: management and investors still require structural capacity reduction and credible cost cuts, while the union and works council reject plant closures and compulsory redundancies, and the state insists closures in its region are off-limits. The positions are clearer, not converged, so another round could still test whether a viable alternative package exists.
